articulation.label: apple
articulation.alt: apple: /æ/ → /p/ → /ə/ → /l/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /æ/: Low front tongue; open the jaw.
/p/: Close the lips, then release the air.
/ə/: Relax the tongue in the center.
/l/: Tip at the ridge; air passes round the sides.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.
